'''Ali Mansour Bakouei Katrimi''' ({{langx|fa|علی باکویی}}; January 17, 1975 {{em dash}} June 13, 2025) was an [[Iranian peoples|Iranian]] [[Nuclear physics|nuclear]] scientist who was involved in the [[Nuclear program of Iran|Iranian nuclear program]]. Bakouei was an academic, renowned for his contributions to [[nuclear physics]], [[materials science]], and [[supercapacitor]] development.<ref>
{{cite web 
|url         = https://news.az/news/the-9-iranian-nuclear-scientists-eliminated-by-israel
|title       = The 9 iranian nuclear scientists eliminated by Israel
|trans-title = ۹ دانشمند هسته‌ای ایرانی توسط اسرائیل کشته شدند
|language    = en
|access-date = 10 August 2025
}}
</ref> He served as an [[assistant professor]], and held various scientific and academic positions throughout his career.<ref>

Bakouei, along with his entire family, died on June 13, 2025, during Israel's initial airstrike of the [[Twelve-Day War]], when his home in the residential neighborhood of [[Narmak]] in [[Tehran]] was targeted.<ref name=irnw/><ref>
{{cite web 
|url         = https://www.corriere.it/esteri/25_giugno_28/iran-regime-decapitato-generali-scienziati-uccisi-7379ffdf-71e3-4f16-a171-990ab635bxlk.shtml

|language    = it

</ref>

== Life ==
Ali Bakouei was born on January 17, 1975 in village of [[Katrim]], [[Dodangeh District]], [[Sari County]], [[Mazandaran province]], [[Iran]]. Ali Bakouei grew up in the village of [[Katrim]], located in the [[Dodangeh District]] of [[Sari County]], [[Iran]].<ref name=ghalamabi/>

From an early age, he was recognized by teachers and peers for his exceptional talent and strong ethical character. While many of his contemporaries spent their leisure time on recreation, he dedicated himself to studying academic and scientific books.<ref name=ghalamabi/>

His father, a hardworking farmer, described him as a well-mannered and helpful son who also assisted with agricultural work.<ref name=ghalamabi/>

In addition to his academic pursuits, Bakouei was active in [[boxing]], serving as both a [[Coach (sport)|coach]] and [[referee]] in [[Tehran Province]]. However, his academic achievements remained largely unknown to many of his colleagues in the sport until after his death.<ref name=ghalamabi>
{{cite web 
|url         = https://ghalamabi.ir/ali-bakouei-katrimi-biography/
|title       = خانه‌ای که خاموش شد؛ شهادت دکتر باکویی و خانواده‌اش
|trans-title = The House That Went Silent: The Martyrdom of Dr. Bakouei and His Family
|language    = fa
|access-date = 10 August 2025
}}
</ref>

He completed his primary and secondary education at his hometown school, then went to [[Sari, Iran|Sari]] to continue his studies. He finished high school at a school in [[Sari, Iran|Sari]] city and prepared to take [[Iranian University Entrance Exam|the national exam for Iranian university entrance]].<ref>
{{cite web 
|url         = https://snn.ir/fa/news/1274785/%D8%B4%D9%87%DB%8C%D8%AF-%D9%87%D8%B3%D8%AA%D9%87%E2%80%8C%D8%A7%DB%8C-%D9%85%D8%A7%D8%B2%D9%86%D8%AF%D8%B1%D8%A7%D9%86-%D8%B1%D8%A7-%D8%A8%DB%8C%D8%B4%D8%AA%D8%B1-%D8%A8%D8%B4%D9%86%D8%A7%D8%B3%DB%8C%D8%AF
|title       = شهید هسته‌ای مازندران را بیشتر بشناسید
|trans-title = Get to know more about the nuclear martyr of Mazandaran
|language    = fa
|access-date = 10 August 2025
}}
</ref>

== Education ==
Bakouei took [[Iranian University Entrance Exam|the national university entrance exam in Iran (''Konkour'')]] and was accepted to study [[mechanical engineering]] at [[Malek-Ashtar University of Technology]] in [[Isfahan]] branch. At the same time, he received a scholarship from the [[Ministry of Defence and Armed Forces Logistics (Iran)|Ministry of Defence and Armed Forces Logistics of Iran]]. After completing his undergraduate studies, he was admitted to the master's program at the same university, where he earned a master's degree in the same field. Following his master's degree in mechanical engineering, he also obtained a doctorate in the same field at the same university.<ref name=hamshahrionline/><ref name=hawzah/><ref name=defapress/> Bakouei later earned another doctorate in [[nuclear physics]] at [[University of Tehran]].<ref name=hamshahrionline>

|title       = زندگینامه دانشمندان شهید هسته‌ ای؛ علی باکویی کتریمی و اکبر مطلبی‌زاده

== Careers ==
Bakouei was an expert in various sciences, including mechanics, and held a PhD in nuclear physics.<ref>
{{cite web 
|url         = https://isis-online.org/isis-reports/significance-of-the-targeted-nuclear-scientists-in-the-12-day-war
|title       = Significance of the Targeted Nuclear Scientists in the 12-Day War
|trans-title = اهمیت دانشمندان هسته‌ای هدف قرار گرفته در جنگ ۱۲ روزه
|language    = en
|access-date = 10 August 2025
}}
</ref> Additionally, he never gave up on sports. Boxing was his favorite sport, and he was preparing for a second-level box coaching certification.<ref name="irna">
{{cite web 
|url         = https://www.irna.ir/news/85878492/%D8%A8%D9%88%DA%A9%D8%B3%D9%88%D8%B1%DB%8C-%DA%A9%D9%87-%D9%86%D8%AA%D8%A7%D9%86%DB%8C%D8%A7%D9%87%D9%88-%D8%B1%D8%A7-%D9%86%D8%A7%DA%A9-%D8%A7%D9%88%D8%AA-%DA%A9%D8%B1%D8%AF-%D8%B4%D9%87%DB%8C%D8%AF-%D8%A8%D8%A7%DA%A9%D9%88%DB%8C%DB%8C-%D8%B9%D8%A7%D8%B4%D9%82-%D8%A7%DB%8C%D8%B1%D8%A7%D9%86
|title       = بوکسوری که «نتانیاهو» را ناک اوت کرد؛ «شهید باکویی» عاشق ایران بود
|trans-title = The boxer who knocked out Netanyahu; the "Martyr Bakouei" loved Iran
|language    = fa
|access-date = 10 August 2025
}}
</ref><ref>
{{cite web 
|url         = https://ut.ac.ir/en/news/48401/science-reserach-and-technology-minister-writes-letter-to-unesco-chief-over-assassination-of-iranian-scientists
|title       = Science, Reserach[sic] and Technology Minister writes letter to UNESCO chief over assassination of Iranian scientists
|trans-title = وزیر علوم، تحقیقات و فناوری در نامه‌ای به رئیس یونسکو در پی ترور دانشمندان ایرانی
|language    = en

Ali Bakouei Katrimi was recognized for his academic aptitude from an early age, dedicating much of his time to studying scientific and educational literature. Although his primary professional field has not been documented in detail, his peers regarded him as having a significant academic standing. In his youth, he helped his family with agricultural work in his native village of [[Katrim]].<ref name=irnw/>

In addition to his scholarly pursuits, Bakouei Katrimi was actively involved in [[boxing]]. He served as a [[Coach (sport)|coach]] and [[referee]] in [[Tehran Province]], contributing significantly to the sport's development at the regional level. However, his academic achievements remained largely unknown to his colleagues within the boxing community until his death.<ref name=irna/>

== Death ==
Bakouei, who had been working as a mechanic instructor for several months after his retirement, was assassinated in an attack on 13 June 2025 by the [[Zionist regime]] and a missile strike on a 10-unit residential apartment building. All members of Bakouei's family (''his wife Mona Bakouei, his 23-year-old daughter Yasamin Bakouei and his 17-year-old son Armin Bakouei'') were killed, but no trace of the body of his daughter, Yasamin Bakouei —a 23-year-old Master's student at [[Sharif University of Technology]]— has been found in the early hours of the incident.<ref>
{{cite web 
|url         = https://www.aparat.com/v/ybs9k15
|title       = یاسمین باکویی؛ خانم شهیدی که از پیکرش فقط یک کف دست ماند
|trans-title = Yasamin Bakouei: A martyred woman whose body was left with only a palm
|language    = fa
|access-date = 10 August 2025
}}
</ref><ref name=irna/> Finally, the identity of the dead was determined by genetic testing.<ref name=defapress/><ref name=atashn>
{{cite web 
|url         = https://akharinkhabar.ir/analysis/10572464/%D8%A2%D8%AA%D8%B4-%D9%86%D8%B4%D8%A7%D9%86%DB%8C-%DA%A9%D9%87-%D9%BE%DB%8C%DA%A9%D8%B1%D9%87%D8%A7%DB%8C-%D8%AE%D8%A7%D9%86%D9%88%D8%A7%D8%AF%D9%87-%D8%A7%D8%B4-%D8%B1%D8%A7-%D8%A7%D8%B2-%D8%B2%DB%8C%D8%B1-%D8%A2%D9%88%D8%A7%D8%B1-%D8%A8%DB%8C%D8%B1%D9%88%D9%86-%D8%A2%D9%88%D8%B1%D8%AF
|title       = آتش‌نشانی که پیکرهای خانواده‌اش را از زیر آوار بیرون آورد
|date = 4 July 2025
|trans-title = The firefighter who pulled his family's bodies from the rubble
|language    = fa
|access-date = 10 August 2025
}}
</ref>

The bodies of Ali Bakouei, his wife, and their children were all buried in [[Sari, Iran]]. Many Iranians attended the funeral ceremony of Ali Bakouei, his wife, and their children.<ref>
{{cite web 
|url         = https://defapress.ir/fa/news/756325/%D9%81%DB%8C%D9%84%D9%85-%D9%88%D8%AF%D8%A7%D8%B9-%D8%A8%D8%A7%D8%B4%DA%A9%D9%88%D9%87-%D8%A8%D8%A7-%D9%BE%DB%8C%DA%A9%D8%B1-%D8%AE%D8%A7%D9%86%D9%88%D8%A7%D8%AF%D9%87-%D8%B4%D9%87%DB%8C%D8%AF-%D8%A8%D8%A7%DA%A9%D9%88%DB%8C%DB%8C-%DA%A9%D8%AA%D8%B1%DB%8C%D9%85%DB%8C-%D8%AF%D8%B1-%D8%B3%D8%A7%D8%B1%DB%8C
|title       = وداع باشکوه با پیکر خانواده شهید «باکویی کتریمی» در ساری
|trans-title = A magnificent farewell to the body of the family of martyr "Bakouei Katrimi" in Sari
|language    = fa
|access-date = 10 August 2025
}}
</ref><ref>

|language    = fa

This attack was one in a series of hostile actions targeting Iranian scientific infrastructure and scientists.<ref name=ghalamabi/>

Bakouei lived in a five-story residential building with ten units. An Israeli airstrike attack completely destroyed the fourth and fifth floors, killing the residents —ordinary people— on those floors. The explosion was so powerful that it created a hole through the floors, leaving no trace of the fourth and fifth levels. This building was residential, and its occupants were ordinary people. It was not affiliated with any organization and was owned by private individuals.<ref name="irna"/>
